summary: Iteration 19 checked three things: (1) the concurrent-session fix, (2) Revoke/Delete regression plus the 401 toast, and (3) the Gmail draft sender account. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass. That is 2 new tests in test_concurrent_sessions.py and 4 regression tests in test_admin_licenses_usage.py. Code review shows POST /api/auth/session now only removes expired sessions ({user_id, expires_at < now}). DB test: inserted 2 unexpired sessions and 1 expired session for user_c709f5461327, ran the same prune, then added a new session. The expired one was removed. Both unexpired tokens and the new token still return 200 from /api/auth/me. test_admin_session_token still works. Frontend (Playwright, admin cookie): Revoke led to the 'License revoked' toast and a Revoked badge. Delete led to the 'License permanently deleted' toast and the row was removed. For the 401 case, the dialog was opened, the cookie was swapped for a bad token, then Confirm was pressed. The toast read exactly 'Your admin login has expired — please sign out and sign in again, then retry.' and the dialog closed. Gift Key: generated a key for giftee@example.com and captured the window.open URL. It starts with https://mail.google.com/mail/u/obsidiancinemaplus@gmail.com/?view=cm and contains to=obsidiancinemaplus%40gmail.com. The body has the recipient and the key and does not contain billrules@gmail.com.

minor.issue: The prune compares expires_at with an ISO string. Session docs whose expires_at is stored as a BSON Date (for example the seeded test_admin_session_token) never match this query, so expired Date-typed sessions are never pruned. This is harmless for correctness because get_current_user still checks expiry. It could be made robust with an $or that also compares against a datetime.

ui_bugs.issue: The regex /^Subject:.*\n\n/ never matches because a 'Recipient:' line follows the Subject line. As a result, the Gmail body starts with 'Subject: ...' and 'Recipient: ...'. Keeping Recipient may be intended, but the Subject line is duplicated in the body.

action_items: Optional: strip only the Subject line from the Gmail body, e.g. emailText.replace(/^Subject:.*\n/, '')
Optional: make the expired-session prune handle Date-typed expires_at as well
critical_code_review_comments: The /u/<email>/ Gmail URL only selects obsidiancinemaplus if that account is signed in within the same browser profile. Otherwise Gmail falls back to the default account or prompts for login. Tell the owner to stay signed into obsidiancinemaplus in that browser.
AdminPage.jsx is 711 lines (over the 700 limit). Consider splitting out GiftEmailTemplate and the tabs.
